fields.label: Style BOM Version
fields.description: Which Style BOM version this submission is judged against. A Fit comment against v2 is meaningless if the record silently became v3 - always set this explicitly.

fields.description: Whether this submission gates BOM generation. PP and Lab Dip should stay checked - informational submission types (Shipment, TOP) can be unchecked.
